title: Migration & Rescue Strategies
objectives: Refactor a legacy app incrementally (strangler pattern)
Run old and new structures side by side safely

examples.name: strangler.txt
examples.code:
phase 0: characterization tests over critical flows
phase 1: introduce features/ skeleton + ports (api clients)
phase 2: migrate one route at a time; new pages use new structure
phase 3: legacy helpers stop growing; fixes go to new modules
phase 4: delete dead legacy code — measure by remaining imports

exercise.prompt: Order the rescue phases: "migrate route by route", "characterization tests", "delete legacy code", "introduce feature skeleton".
hints: Safety net first, structure second, cleanup last.
Strangler = new growth around the old until the old is gone.

options: incrementally, route by route, behind the same URL
questions.explanation: Incremental migration keeps shipping value while structure improves.
Import counts are an honest, mechanical measure of what still depends on the old world.
